digest.component_or_area: Plan review caching and prompt structure
propositions: The Pass-1 finder and Pass-2 verifier prompts currently render through different paths with no shared plan-bearing prefix, preventing Anthropic cache reuse across passes and within verifier chunks
Moving the plan from verifier user message into system prompt (via shared_prefix) enables within-pass cache reuse across verifier chunks and cross-run prefix reuse within the cache TTL

A single-source structural invariant in prompts.py ensures byte-identical plan-bearing prefix across Pass-1 finder and both verifiers, preventing drift and positioning prompts for provider-side prefix reuse
The Pass-1 warm gate must measure the actual prefix bytes (preamble + plan) not the plan alone, so _prefix_tokens measures shared_plan_prefix(plan) against CACHE_MIN_PREFIX_TOKENS
An exhaustiveness directive bullet in SHARED_STANCE_PREAMBLE requires Pass-1 to enumerate every independent defect found in the current run rather than deferring findings to later review rounds
